name: Spinner
summary: A small turning ring that says something is busy and its length is unknown.
useWhen: A short wait of unknown length on a small area: a list row, a card, a field that checks a value
Next to visible text such as Loading files, as decorative
Inside a region that carries aria-busy, as decorative
avoidWhen: The task reports how far it is
The layout is known while content loads
A wait longer than a few seconds with no visible text

size.description: Ring size: xs 12 (size.icon.sm), sm 16 (size.icon.md), md 24 (size.icon.lg), lg 36 px with a thicker stroke.

tone.description: neutral draws the arc in color.text.default, accent in color.primary.on-surface (the neutral fill in Studio, yellow in Desk dark, dark gold in Desk light).

label.description: The accessible name, read by a status region: Loading files. Required unless decorative (a TypeScript union enforces it). Never rendered as visible text.

decorative.description: Sets aria-hidden and drops the status role and the label. Use it when visible text or an aria-busy parent already says the area is busy.

a11y.role: status (with a label), or none and aria-hidden (decorative)
a11y.announce: With a label, the root is a polite status region holding the visually hidden label. It is read when a screen reader reaches it and when the label changes; a region inserted with its text already in it is not announced by every reader. Decorative spinners say nothing. aria-hidden is ignored on the labelled form.
notes: Under reduced motion the ring stops and stays as a still ring with its arc; the label is still read.
Under forced colors the ring is GrayText with a CanvasText arc, so it does not collapse into one color.
Many spinners on one view: make them decorative and say the busy state once, in a region with aria-busy or in one status line.
The turn is clockwise in both directions: a spinner is a clock and does not mirror in RTL.
WCAG 2.2.2: a busy indicator is essential motion, but a wait longer than five seconds should show visible text or move to ProgressBar.

en.label: Name the work in progress, a present participle plus a noun: Loading files, Syncing boards. Not Please wait.
en.visible: When the wait is longer than a second or two, show the same words next to a decorative spinner.

ar.label: Noun form with جار: جار تحميل الملفات، جار مزامنة اللوحات. No diacritics.

react.note: Motion: the spinner pattern from the 1.11 catalog list, today a CSS rotate keyframe on duration.spin, none under reduced motion.

native.note: Expected on ActivityIndicator or a Reanimated rotation, still under reduce motion.

styles.studio: A 2px ring in overlay 20 with a text colored arc; accent uses the neutral fill of Studio, the same as neutral in effect.
styles.desk: The same ring; accent turns the arc yellow on dark and dark gold on light, from color.primary.on-surface.
styles.neutral: Planned: the same ring with the brand color for accent.

mistakes.wrong: A spinner with role status next to visible text that says the same thing
mistakes.right: decorative on the spinner, the visible text carries the meaning

mistakes.wrong: Ten labelled spinners in a list, each announcing Loading
mistakes.right: Decorative spinners and one aria-busy region or one status line

mistakes.wrong: A spinner while an upload reports its percent
mistakes.right: A ProgressBar or a ProgressCircle with the value

mistakes.wrong: A Spinner placed inside a busy Button by hand
